title: With Tesla Roadster debut, Elon Musk shows "flying cars are real" - CBS News
description: Elon Musk unveiled Tesla's new Roadster, which uses high-pressure air thrusters to leave the road entirely during a livestreamed event at his SpaceX facility in Texas.

title: New photos show Pope Leo celebrating Mass at hospital as he recovers from lung cancer surgery - CBS News
description: The Vatican also released photos of some get-well notes that had been sent to Pope Leo from patients in the hospital's pediatric oncology ward.

title: Brush fires trigger evacuations in Los Angeles, Orange counties amid Santa Ana winds across SoCal - ABC7 Los Angeles
description: Strong Santa Ana winds are whipping across Southern California, and even stronger winds are expected Friday as the dangerous conditions spark fires across the region and leave tens of thousands without power.

title: Selma Blair ‘did not intend to harm anyone’ in airplane incident, rep says in first statement since arrest - NBC News
description: A representative for Selma Blair came to her defense on Friday, just days after the actress pleaded not guilty after being arrested on two counts of second-degree assault in connection to a physical incident on a plane.
